entities.summary: Jeffrey Robert Haines is an American prelate of the Catholic Church who has been serving as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Milwaukee in Wisconsin since 2017. He also served as rector of the Cathedral of St. John the Evangelist in Milwaukee from 2011 to 2023.
